findings.title: Load-side busbar over 120 percent on the PV breaker rating
findings.message: 705.12(B)(3)(2): PV breaker 70 A (parser) + 200 A main (parser) = 270 A, above 120 % of the 200 A (parser) busbar (1.2 x 200 = 240 A) by 30 A. Measured on the PV breaker rating because the inverter output current is not stated; 125 percent of that current is the 2017+ NEC test and may pass. Values marked (parser) were read by the parser but not found stated on the sheets (pvBreaker, busRating, mainBreaker); confirm them before treating this as a rejection.
findings.cityFeedback: The load-side connection exceeds the 120 percent busbar allowance on the PV breaker rating. Revise: de-rate the main, connect supply side, upgrade the service panel, or provide another 705.12(B)(3) compliant method.
findings.designTeamAction: State the inverter's maximum continuous output current and quantity on the SLD (the 2017+ test may then pass), or correct the interconnection and show the 705.12(B)(3)(2) calculation.
evidenceNeeded: Inverter maximum continuous output current and quantity
